test_title: PYST 36: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 25 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The cloth is ______ to touch so it is not suitable for apparels.
solution: The correct answer is '**coarse**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Coarse**: In the context of textiles, '**coarse**' means rough or loose in texture or grain. (कठोर or मोटा) • The sentence "*The cloth is **coarse **__to touch so it is not suitable for apparels*" indicates that the rough texture of the cloth makes it unsuitable for clothing. • Hence, the correct word to fill in the blank is '**coarse**'. Therefore, the correct answer is "**Option 4**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Soft**: Having a pleasing quality involving a subtle effect. (सूक्ष्म प्रभाव से युक्त मनभावन गुण होना) • **Irregular**: Something that is not even or balanced in shape or arrangement. (कुछ ऐसा जो आकार या व्यवस्था में सम या संतुलित न हो) • **Smooth**: An even and regular surface, free from perceptible projections, lumps, or indentations. (एक समान और नियमित सतह, जो प्रत्यक्ष प्रक्षेपणों, गांठों या खरोजों से मुक्त हो) 36:T5e7, The correct answer is: "**haven't they?**"
